author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not swallow/catch an error as a workaround at the call site; fix the race condition or precondition violation that causes it.
fix_shape: remove the catch that swallows the error and fix the caller so the precondition (e.g. storage still open) always holds

author: dmaretskyi
principle: If a workaround compensates for reaching a built artifact that source-resolution should have prevented, treat it as a sign of misconfiguration to fix, not a permanent code path.
fix_shape: investigate and fix the package config causing the fallback instead of special-casing it

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not export an internal implementation detail (like a raw schema helper) unless something outside the module actually needs it.
fix_shape: drop the export or make the binding module-private

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not construct a branded/validated value with a type cast in a test; generate it through the real constructor/generator so it is actually valid.
fix_shape: replace `as BrandedType` literals with calls to the type's constructor or a test generator

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not construct a branded/validated value with a type cast in a test; generate it through the real constructor/generator so it is actually valid.
fix_shape: use the type's helper constructor instead of casting a string literal

author: wittjosiah
principle: A branded/opaque type should ship with a constructor helper for creating valid instances, not just a validator.
fix_shape: add a `make`/`from...` helper alongside the type guard

author: wittjosiah
principle: Fix the type so it flows through inference rather than casting to force a mismatch.
fix_shape: adjust the source/target types so no cast is needed at the call site

author: wittjosiah
principle: A validation function like `X.isValid` should be written as a type guard (`value is X`) so it narrows the type, removing the need for a downstream cast.
fix_shape: change the validator's signature to a type predicate instead of casting after calling it

author: wittjosiah
principle: Fix the type so it flows through inference rather than casting to force a mismatch.
fix_shape: derive the branded type from a validating helper instead of casting

author: wittjosiah
principle: Rename a function when its behavior or return type changes so the name still matches what it does.
fix_shape: rename the function to reflect its new return type

author: wittjosiah
principle: Rename a function when its behavior or return type changes so the name still matches what it does.
fix_shape: rename the function to reflect its new input/output type

author: wittjosiah
principle: Keep the most specific/branded type for a value (e.g. a DXN) rather than loosening it to a broader type (raw URI or string) in an annotation or signature.
fix_shape: keep the specific branded type instead of widening to string/URI

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not add a type cast unless it is actually required; verify the cast is load-bearing before keeping it.
fix_shape: remove the unnecessary cast if the value already has the right type

author: richburdon
principle: Do not add both a singular and a batch variant of a method; accept an array parameter and drop the singular overload.
fix_shape: remove add()/addMany() duplication and keep one method taking an array (or single item wrapped in one)

author: richburdon
principle: Use one consistent private-member convention (`#field` or `_field`) within a class rather than mixing both.
fix_shape: pick one privacy convention and apply it consistently across the class

author: richburdon
principle: An error message for an unsupported or unexpected case should include the actual value encountered, not just a static description.
fix_shape: interpolate the actual ast.type (or equivalent) into the thrown error message

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Intersect a brand marker onto the semantic base type rather than onto raw `string`, so the nominal type stays anchored to its real domain type.
fix_shape: reorder the intersection so the domain type (e.g. URI.URI) is the base and the brand is layered on top

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use Effect's `Brand.Brand<'...'>` utility to create a nominal/branded type rather than hand-rolling an intersection with a unique symbol.
fix_shape: replace the hand-rolled `string & { unique symbol }` brand with effect's Brand utility

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add wrapper functions for operations that are already trivial on the underlying primitive (e.g. a branded string); expose it directly instead.
fix_shape: delete the trivial wrapper (e.g. an `equals` doing `===`) and let callers compare the values directly

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use Effect's `Brand.Brand<'...'>` utility to create a nominal/branded type rather than hand-rolling an intersection with a unique symbol, and drop trivial wrapper functions around a plain string.
fix_shape: apply the same Brand-based typing and remove redundant string-wrapper helpers

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a cheap check (e.g. a prefix match) for a fast-path type guard, and reserve full validation (a regex) for where strict parsing is actually required.
fix_shape: replace the regex test in the hot-path guard with a simple startsWith check

author: dmaretskyi
principle: For deterministic test fixtures, rely on predictably generated ids rather than post-hoc regex redaction of value formats.
fix_shape: revert the redaction patterns and lean on the existing deterministic-id generation instead

author: dmaretskyi

author: dmaretskyi

fix_shape: keep $id as the sole reference and remove the duplicate field

author: dmaretskyi

fix_shape: delete the deprecated duplicate field and keep the single replacement
